author: Porkyyy
body:
When the Avicore update came out, the website was remodeled, but lost a feature which I often used; the search bar.
This was a good feature because it allowed you to find threads that you want to see in an easier way, without having to look through several pages to find it. This is useful because it saves your time, and is overall a more efficient way to navigate the forums.

This is what it looked like in the old forums:


This feature allowed you to search for specific topics, as well as the author of certain topics.

Opinions?
